## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Implement `ExtractLabelValues` and its fixed Agent role action using the dedicated Labeling model. Reuse System credentials, ProviderSpec, and the supported ReqLLM endpoint. Add only the required operation-specific configuration/runtime handling; preserve translation/title behavior.
Files: New lib/zaq/agent/actions/extract_label_values.ex; agent/api.ex; reuse provider_spec.ex, System.OperationModelConfig and ReqLLM generation APIs.

## Tests to add before implementation
configured/unconfigured/unsupported models, valid found/not-found results, unknown and duplicate label IDs, malformed/oversized values, refusal, timeout, input limits, and prompt-injection content. Stub external HTTP only; keep provider normalization and Action validation real. Update Agent/System configuration docs and operation schemas.
Immediate unit/integration/property/LiveView tests apply to implementation issues. Feature E2E scenarios are defined early but authoring waits for the human UX approval issue. Existing test behavior changes require explicit human approval.

## Branches/paths validated
configured/unconfigured/unsupported models, valid found/not-found results, unknown and duplicate label IDs, malformed/oversized values, refusal, timeout, input limits, and prompt-injection content. Stub external HTTP only; keep provider normalization and Action validation real. Update Agent/System configuration docs and operation schemas.
Preserve agreed lifecycle: stable document ID/manual document values; deleted/replaced chunks lose every old assignment; configured dedicated text Labeling model and per-target automatic settings gate inference.

## Mocking plan
Use real Repo, permissions, domain contexts, Action validation and dispatch wherever practical. Control only external LLM/embedding/conversion/provider HTTP and genuine nondeterministic boundaries. Runtime opts use Zaq.Config.get/4. No broad global mocks or sleep-based coordination. Review/approval-only steps need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
docs/services/agent.md, docs/services/system-config.md and new Action schema documentation. Keep this Page's final specification aligned; progress remains in Beadwork.

## Action reuse assessment
New tool-free ExtractLabelValues Action. TranslateKnowledgeQuery is a structural reference but semantically translation, not extraction; do not extend its business behavior. Reuse ProviderSpec.operation_runtime, System labeling config and actual ReqLLM generation contract. Inputs bounded content and label IDs/descriptions; output validated found/not_found values or safe errors. Agent event confidential; no persistence or tools/history. Invocation Jido.Exec.run/3, no Registry exposure. Verify HTTP fixtures, prompt/data separation and malformed output rejection.

## Validation and prerequisites
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md. All cross-service BO calls use NodeRouter.dispatch/1 and explicit Event action. No commit/push/merge authorized. Dependencies are the serial reviewable delivery sequence; only the architecture gate should initially be ready.
